weather_day.src: Assumption (Pohang ASOS wind statistics can replace it): daytime mix of D / 5 m/s, D / 3 m/s and calm

weather_night.src: Assumption: night-time mix of F / 2 m/s, D / 3 m/s and calm

p_ign.src: TNO Purple Book (CPR 18E) table 4.3: continuous release of flammable gas < 10 kg/s, immediate + delayed ignition

p_ign_worker.src: Assumption: ignition source brought by the worker at the valve (tools, torch, static) per visit; hot-work rules apply

p_fat_flash_small.src: Assumption: fatality given ignition while inside the sub-metre plume at the vent (face/hand burns likely, death unlikely); TNO uses 1.0 for engulfment in large clouds

p_fat_flash_R5.src: TNO Green Book: fatality 1.0 inside the flash-fire envelope of the 30-s depressurisation cloud (LFL 6-13 m)

p_zone.src: Assumption from the plume geometry (radius 0.1-0.4 m at the LFL distance): probability that a person at 1 m from the vent is inside the flammable plume

p_zone_R5.src: Assumption: the 30-s depressurisation cloud (LFL 6-13 m) covers most of the roof

p_zone_routine.src: Assumption: random position on the roof (radius ~10 m) vs. a plume a few metres long

t_at_valve_min.src: Assumption: minutes a responding operator spends at a venting valve

t_fix_min.src: Assumption: minutes from arrival until the venting is stopped (flare restart, bypass, clearing the blockage)

p_in_plume_h2s.src: Assumption: probability that the visit involves a prolonged stay inside the H2S plume (downwind of the vent, leaning over it) despite the personal H2S alarm (10 ppm) that plant staff carry; 0.1-0.3 without a detector (tornado)

lsir_distance_m.src: Location-specific IR evaluated for a permanent presence 3 m from the vent (roof walkway)

p_roof_day.src: Assumption: probability that the responding operator goes up to the digester roof while the valve vents (day)

routine_day.src: Assumption: daily 5-min inspection at each PVRV + 24 h/yr maintenance, within the daytime hours (08-20)

routine_night.src: Assumption: no routine presence at night

p_fouled.src: Assumption: probability that foam reaching the digester outlet also fouls the PVRV. The BN uses 0.3 for the opening branch; 0.1 here keeps the seal-failure chain (0.6 x 0.1 x not prevented) near the EA 2019 incident base rate

p_injury_seal.src: Assumption: fatality probability for a person on the roof at the moment a roof seal / manhole fails at 10 kPag

p_on_roof_at_failure.src: Assumption: share of the responders who are on the roof at the moment the seal fails (27 min after the blockage)

generic_f_pvrv.src: Generic-QRA comparison: spurious / demand-driven PVRV opening 1e-2 per valve-year (CCPS-type initiating-event value), 2 valves
